question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Whim
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4 (Fancy)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Whim"** refers to a sudden desire or idea that is not based on reason or consistent thought; it is often impulsive. (झुक या अचानक विचार)

 
 
• **Example:** On a whim, she decided to take a road trip to the mountains without planning ahead.
 
 
 
• **"Fancy"** is synonymous with whim as it also refers to an imaginative or impulsive idea. (कल्पना)
 
 
• **Example:** He bought that expensive car just because of a fancy he had about driving it.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate synonym for **"Whim"** is **"Fancy"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 (Fancy)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Antiquity **(प्राचीनता): Refers to ancient times or the quality of being old.

 
 
• **Example:** The artifacts in the museum date back to antiquity.
 
 
 
• **Factualness **(तथ्यात्मकता): Refers to the quality of being based on facts.
 
 
• **Example:** The factualness of her report impressed the committee.
 
 
 
• **Bloodiness **(रक्तरंजितता): Refers to the state of being bloody or violent.
 
 
• **Example:** The battle was marked by its bloodiness and high casualties.
